detail.title: Mechanisms of Autonomous Inquiry and Problem Formulation
detail.summary: This WAKE✳︎ institutional cycle continues our exploration of autonomous problem formulation and scientific discovery processes, focusing on structured search, multi-agent co-evolution, and discrepancy-driven evaluation. We examine current agentic frameworks that facilitate autonomous discovery.
